final_report: The patient exhibits profound bone marrow suppression with grade 4 febrile neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and recurrent neutropenia, indicating severe myelosuppression and immunocompromise. Rapid progression of infectious pleural effusion to fatal grade 5 reflects multi-organ failure and high disease burden. Comorbid atrial fibrillation and anemia further compromise cardiovascular reserve, portending imminent mortality despite interventions.
